name: example-sentinel
description: PATTERN: agent pane + an ALWAYS-VISIBLE ambient sentinel, not a one-shot check. Do this for a repo that's a checkout multiple concurrent sessions might touch: a nonempty stash list means another session was here, not that your work vanished. Copy this into your personal tier (see README's Private vs. public) and point working_dir at your own repo.

panes.label: Sentinel
panes.cmd:
while :; do clear; printf '=== sentinel  %s ===
' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"; echo; echo '-- uncommitted --'; git status --short; echo; echo '-- stash (nonempty = ANOTHER session touched this checkout — git stash apply, never pop) --'; git stash list; sleep 60; done
